saw_lines: People ordering alcohol for tonight want it at the door fast, and they pick whoever shows the delivery time first.
So the sale is won on the first screen, where delivery speed and the local store decide the click.
Your site promises delivery in 30 to 60 minutes from local stores, and your 2 Google text ads are your only paid creative. Lead the next ones with that window.
